protocol.count: Original 232 early-CV / 96 calibration / 42 holdout cases; h0 pools h1..4
protocol.spike: 2025 local jump above max(1.5*mean4,1.5*last); h0 pools h2..4; labels depend on issue
protocol.escalation: Annual mean + 2 sample std, target excluded, minimum 48/52 weeks; fixed 7-day truth; canonical labels
protocol.escalation_training: 44 expanding refits, every 4 weeks; 37 model variants + 2 controls with foundation enabled
protocol.escalation_signal: Count forecast > issue-known annual threshold; classifier probability > 0.5
protocol.advance: h2/h3/h4: 6.5/13.5/20.5 days; h1 is already-started week
protocol.limitations: Retrospective configurations; foundation weights postdate historical test, pretraining overlap unknown

count.selection_method: Fixed explicitly in config; retrospective user choice
